name: Lucerne
flagName: Flag of the Canton of Lucerne
summary: A square divided vertically into blue at the hoist and white at the fly. Lucerne joined the Confederacy in 1332, the first city to do so.
origin: The blue and white banner is recorded from the 14th century.
facts: Lucerne was the first city to join the three founding cantons.
Zug's flag is also blue and white, with a horizontal blue band.
clues: A square split vertically into blue and white.
The first city to join the Swiss founding cantons.
